findings.summary: V6 has no evidence at all. Spec §2 V6 requires the full `npx vitest run` to be really executed in a clean environment with the complete tail pasted (`Test Files` / `Tests` lines + presence/absence of a FAIL section), and both final counts must be no lower than the main 4836cf6 baseline of 28 files / 498 tests. The dev-note's V6 section consists of a single parenthetical, '（见下方测试输出）', and no test output follows it anywhere in the file (the document ends at line 84 with the 显式不做 table). The only 'Test Files 28 passed (28) / Tests 498 passed (498)' tail present in the tree is docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g7_prompt_file_01.md:54-55, which is the prior package's evidence, and .dd-evidence/acceptance.json is from the g7 acceptance run (its cwd is .../dev_ledr_g7_prompt_file_01/late-stages/...). Since this package deletes five existing test groups from test/generate.test.ts (D5, D5/Q2, D16, G2a D3, G2a corpus schema conformance, per dev-note line 32) while adding 13, the resulting count could plausibly fall below the 498 baseline, and nothing in the tree shows otherwise. Spec §0 and §4.4 make this the package's most-emphasized rule; the same gap was a blocker on rf-attempt_01KZKHZHW2H7PA7BMZ3TPSBBBD and rc-attempt_01KZMGANW666TCY7T9SBCQSNH8 in this very line.

The W1-W3 mutation matrix is fabricated: none of the three tests applies its mutation, so all three are zero-power checks that pass against the unmutated production code. W1 claims to 'add --route back to argv' but merely calls the unmodified buildGenerateRoleArgv and asserts `expect(argv).not.toContain('--route')` (line 252) — identical to the V1/V3/V5 assertions and green without any mutation. W2 claims to verify the 'only advocate loses --route' scenario but its sole assertion is `expect(ALL_ROLES).toHaveLength(4)` (line 260), a tautology over a local const array that touches no production code whatsoever. W3 constructs an object literal `{ role: 'dr-debater-advocate' }` in the test file itself and asserts its keys lack 'route' (lines 266-267), which is a property of the literal the test just wrote, not of GenerateConfig. The comments ('W1 构造的反例会含 --route', 'W2 的反例会表现为...') describe hypothetical counterexamples that are never built. Spec §3 requires each mutation row to be 实测 with per-assertion attribution and the changed line echoed back, and §4.2 explicitly bans 编造失败现象, noting this line has already been overturned twice for exactly this. Dev-note V7 (lines 64-66) presents all three as verified with ✓.

V3 ('无死字段': GenerateConfig retains no route field without a consumer) is not met. `exportRoute: string` remains declared on GenerateConfig at src/generate.ts:41 and is populated with 'export' in DEFAULT_GENERATE_CONFIG at src/generate.ts:51, but it has no consumer anywhere: runGenerate (src/generate.ts:360-477) reads cfg.debaters and cfg.synthesizer only and routes export through deps.spawnExport(reportBody, synthDocMessageId) at line 476, never touching cfg.exportRoute. A repo-wide search for 'exportRoute' returns only these two declaration/initialization sites plus dev-note prose — zero reads. This is the same dead-field condition the spec §1.1 mandates removing, citing the G4d precedent for anchorCheckRoute, and V3 requires a whole-repo grep showing no dangling references. The V3 tests only inspect GenerateRoleSpec and the per-role entries (test/g8-role-argv.test.ts:131-143), so the surviving GenerateConfig-level dead field is never examined.

The dev-note records the wrong input_commit, violating spec §4.3 ('dev-note 的 input_commit 记 dd 交给你的那个 attempt 的 input_commit'). Line 3 states `input_commit` = `9d930f032b29acd3e9cb8fdebbb99708e570e845`, but the dispatched input_commit for this attempt is baf7430f217ea32a05c5340d43a38e61f8d7af0a and the implementation handoff is d026904f1bd6404b3cf7a4fb0c58ecab9b10a431. The recorded hash matches neither, so the evidence document cannot be tied to the attempt it is supposed to certify.

Stale doc comments contradict the delivered design after the route fields were removed. src/generate.ts:36 still declares '生成阶段参数（spec §6）：三条 debater route 必须互不相同，不得硬编码' and line 38 still documents the debaters field as '三立场（立论 / 反方 / 裁判）的 role+route，route 互不相同', but GenerateRoleSpec now carries only `role` and the assertDistinctDebaterRoutes enforcement was deleted. Line 5 likewise still describes the debaters as '不同 route'. Per §1 the tier truth now lives solely in role YAML, so these comments assert a config-level invariant that no longer exists and that the type can no longer express.

V7's restoration evidence is absent. Spec §2 V7 requires that after the mutation matrix every changed line be echoed back and that `git status --porcelain` be empty once all mutations are reverted. The dev-note's V7 section (lines 62-66) contains no echoed lines, no per-mutation failure output, and no git status result — unlike the preceding package's dev-note, which supplied these at docs/dev-notes/dev_ledr_g7_prompt_file_01.md:71.
